Preserve explicit sentinel copies and source return codes, except allocation abort behavior of infallible Rust construction. Native Rust capacity is not a C ABI promise. Geometry retains original integer operation order, unsigned underflow via wrapping_sub, default/env settings; invalid numeric env throws via Rust panic instead of C++ exception. QuerySplitProgram is a scoped ordinary C++ EProgram adapter distinguishing classic/megablast/tblastn; no unsupported translated-query public search is introduced. HitList merge uses exact source rank/heap/cap behavior and typed take ownership; ascending OID comparator avoids signed-subtraction overflow for valid nonnegative OIDs.
translations.validation: Focused unchanged-original comparisons:14 core storage/accessor functions over4blocks/10chunks compare bounds,count,query/context/offset arrays including sentinels,allow_gap,overlap and null-error outputs;140 default+140 OVERLAP_CHUNK_SIZE=21 geometry inputs compare chunk count and adjusted size, including tiny-size unsigned-wrap edge;24 query HSPListsMerge cases compare complete HSP scores/context/endpoints/seeds/order/listcounts/capacity/consumption across plus/minus query frames,invalid offset-1 and allow_gap on/off;12 complete HitListMerge cases compare OID ordering,per-HSP fields/counts,heap flags,capacity,low_score,ownership. Temporary /tmp/btyper-query-{storage,geometry,merge,hitlist}*. All exact on this platform. New module standalone compilation and cargo check existing exposed modules pass. These checks do not establish full split-search parity or speed.
